messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Is the updated rstan working properly?
parts:
What have you updated?  Given the error you have, I do not think rstan can be installed/updated.  But if it is xcode 5 on Mac, see here http://stackoverflow.com/questions/19503995/error-when-with-xcode-5-0-and-rcpp-command-line-tools-are-installed

If you are using Xcode 5 on Mac OS X Mavericks, you might need to modify CXX in your Makevars file as indicated by 
https://groups.google.com/d/msg/stan-users/_7Lu0ahphik/T75QWqLcsTwJ

--
Jiqiang
